summaryNote: This is the current TCG Forbidden & Limited List and is what governs the NAWCQ 2026 main event. No Chaos Origins (CORI) cards are Forbidden, Limited, or Semi-Limited as of this list — the set released after this list took effect. Below are the actual changes made in the May 18, 2026 update (verified against the official list), not the full exhaustive list — always cross-check the official Konami list before locking in your deck list. Two evergreen reminders for the sample decklists on this site: Baronne de Fleur remains Forbidden, and Called by the Grave remains Limited to 1.
